title: Gujarat Budget 2026-27 Declares 'Gujarat Tourism Year'
shortDescription: Finance Minister Kanu Desai's 2026-27 Budget declares 2026 'Gujarat Tourism Year', funding bus ports at Somnath and Ambaji, the Statue of Unity, and the Lothal maritime museum.
genZNote: Somnath, Ambaji, Statue of Unity, Lothal — if it's a Gujarat heritage site and it got budget money in 2026, it's tourism-year current affairs.

sections.heading: What Happened
sections.body: Presenting Gujarat's 2026-27 Budget, Finance Minister Kanu Desai declared 2026 as "Gujarat Tourism Year" and set out allocations to strengthen heritage, pilgrimage, and coastal tourism infrastructure across the state, alongside a new "Wed in Gujarat" destination-wedding promotional campaign.

sections.heading: Key Facts
bullets: ₹447 crore allocated for bus ports at Somnath and Ambaji, two of Gujarat's major pilgrimage centres.
₹236 crore allocated for infrastructure development at the Statue of Unity (Kevadia).
₹95 crore earmarked for the National Maritime Heritage Museum at Lothal, one of the Indus Valley Civilization's oldest port sites.
New "Wed in Gujarat" campaign launched to position the state as a wedding/destination-tourism hub.

sections.heading: Why It Matters
sections.body: This budget item is a natural bridge to static GK: Lothal connects directly to Ancient India (Indus Valley Civilization port city), while Somnath and the Statue of Unity are recurring Gujarat-specific landmarks in tourism and culture questions. The 'Tourism Year' framing also ties Gujarat's economic-development current affairs to its heritage GK.

commonConfusion: Lothal is an ANCIENT (Indus Valley) heritage site getting a MODERN (2026) museum allocation — don't confuse the site's age with the funding's date.

highYieldFacts: Gujarat declared 2026 as its official 'Tourism Year' in the 2026-27 state budget.
Lothal — one of the Indus Valley Civilization's oldest ports — received a dedicated 2026 museum allocation.
commonTraps: Mixing up which allocation went to which site (Somnath/Ambaji vs Statue of Unity vs Lothal).
